messages:
Maria L: Heads-up: after the canary deploy to dedicated pools we started seeing OOMs on long-chat workloads (~12-14k tokens). Not consistent but spiky around batch boundaries.
Aj Patel: Seeing kernel fallback to the generic matmul path in the logs right before the OOM. Attach: perf snapshot + small flame.
Samir K: Can you paste the fallback trace? If kernel selection happens too late we end up with a big workspace allocation for the optimized kernel then fallback frees+realloc and fragments.
Aj Patel: log excerpt:
```
[2026-06-07T16:05:12Z] kernel_selector: chosen=paged-attn-fast (requires ws=1.6GB)
[2026-06-07T16:05:12Z] runtime: cannot reserve workspace (available=1.1GB) -> fallback to paged-attn-generic
[2026-06-07T16:05:12Z] allocator: attempted_alloc 512MB -> OOM
```
Henry T: That pattern screams "late-bind kernel + eager reserve". If we reserve big ws when batch arrives and then reroute/buffer-swap later, the allocator gets holes. We should try delaying reserve until routing settled + ephemeral buffer reuse.
Maria L: Also saw KV cache churn in the same window. KV eviction + compaction runs coincided with the fallback. Possibly compaction paused and then heavy reclaim kicked off.
Samir K: Proposed approach: 1) Do lightweight kernel scoring pre-routing (cheap heuristic) 2) Reserve a smaller guaranteed slice (e.g., 25% of worst-case ws) 3) After batch routing finalizes, attempt atomic upgrade to full workspace with try_reserve(); if fails, fall back gracefully.
Aj Patel: Bench results from a quick patch: 10% fewer OOMs, tail latency reduced by ~40ms, but compaction still triggers in some cases. Patch link: https://rwd/repo/patch/late-bind-kernel (WIP)
Henry T: Another knob: deferrable compaction. If compaction is paused while try_reserve is pending, we reduce contention. But that risks long-term fragmentation. Maybe make it timebox-limited (150ms).
Maria L: Can we add a metric for "kernel selected vs kernel executed" mismatch rate? Right now it's noisy to correlate.
Samir K: Agreed. Add counters: kernel_candidate, kernel_finalized, kernel_fallback_reason. Also instrument allocator: reservation_attempts, reservation_fail_reason.
InfraBot: Deploy scheduled: canary:late-bind-kernel at 2026-06-08T02:00Z. Rollout policy: 5% -> 25% -> 100% if no OOM spikes.
Aj Patel: Running a focused repro in lab with forced compaction + mixed seq lengths. Will dump allocator traces and KV hit/miss timeline.
Maria L: Thanks — keep the thread updated. If we see regressions, revert the canary. :thumbsup:
Samir K: I'll start a short RFC for late-binding semantics + compaction timeboxing. Want this to be opt-in for a few weeks.
Henry T: Also adding a small allocator patch: prefer slab rebind over big free+alloc for workspace upgrades. Quick proto attached in the patch.
Aj Patel: Proto reduced peak resident by ~220MB in lab. Pushing traces to the perf bucket.
Maria L: Perfect. Next steps: land metrics + opt-in canary + extend rollout window. List of artifacts: perf traces, allocator logs, canary dashboard.
